NEWS UPDATE: The Office of Student Regent (OSR) has issued Memorandum No. OSR-RDLC 2025-001 urging all student councils and students to participate in the Systemwide Day of Action for Higher University of the Philippines (UP) Budget on Sept. 25, coinciding with the national budget deliberations for state universities and colleges (SUCs)

Following UP’s largest budget cut in the decade amounting to Php 2.08-billion for fiscal year 2025, the proposed Php 46.85-billion budget for FY 2026 is set to suffer a Php 21-billion deficit under the National Expenditure Program.

In line with GASC Resolution No. 2025-017, which pushes for a stronger campaign for higher budget for the state subsidy, the OSR enjoined all the nation’s scholars to stage protest actions and different forms of mobilization to press demand for sufficient funding.
